definitions:
caught          a gold span is caught when predicted spans of the matching
                  class (NAME for the two name labels) cover at least 50% of its
                  characters. Coverage is the union of predicted spans, so a
                  full name tagged as given name + surname counts.
  exact           some predicted NAME span has exactly the gold boundaries
                  (predicted spans are trimmed of surrounding whitespace first).
  any_label       as `caught`, counting predicted spans of every class.
  pooled CI       95% Wilson interval over all seeds' mentions. The five seeds
                  replant the same dialogues, so mentions are not independent
                  across seeds and the pooled intervals are narrower than a
                  dialogue-level interval would be; mean and SD across seeds
                  are reported beside them.
  lower bound     exact binomial (Clopper-Pearson) one-sided 95% lower bound,
                  the bound the 3/n rule approximates at zero misses.
  precision       predicted NAME spans that overlap a gold name span / all
                  predicted NAME spans, on the planted sets; a second figure
                  leaves word-problem characters out of the denominator (v1).
  over-redaction  predicted NAME spans per 1,000 whitespace tokens on the
                  untouched control (on PIILO: NAME spans overlapping no gold
                  span), with the share on curricular terms (names/curricular_terms.txt)
                  and on word-problem characters (MathDial).
stratum_definition:
Surface form of a name mention, and the strata built from it.

One record per planted mention (written by plant.py into the gold file):

  case          lower | cap | allcaps     first letter lowercase; first letter
                                          uppercase; two or more letters, all uppercase
  speaker       student | tutor           the turn the mention sits in
  position      first | later             first mention of that person in the dialogue,
                                          or any later one (nickname/initial forms are later;
                                          a classmate or relative is mentioned once, so first)
  category      the name list the dialogue drew from
  is_dict_word  the mention's first whitespace token, lowercased, is in
                names/english_words.txt (lowercase entries of SCOWL american-english,
                63,875 words); single letters are not words, so an initial is never one
  n_wordpieces  DeBERTa-v3 pieces of the mention text (tokenizer of the pinned model)
  is_initial    one letter and a period ("R.")

PRIMARY STRATUM = case x speaker x is_dict_word, with case folded to two
levels (lower | upper, upper = cap or allcaps): 2 x 2 x 2 = 8 strata. This is
the one definition the floor-transfer test uses; `primary_stratum` is it.
label_map:
Each detector's own labels -> {NAME, SCHOOL, EMAIL, PHONE, OTHER}.

Name recall, the primary metric, counts only spans mapped to NAME here.
Anything a detector flags that is not in its table is OTHER.

| detector    | NAME                       | SCHOOL                                   | EMAIL         | PHONE        |
|-------------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------|---------------|--------------|
| edshield    | NAME_STUDENT, NAME_RELATED | SCHOOL                                   | EMAIL         | PHONE_NUM    |
| presidio    | PERSON                     | LOCATION, ORGANIZATION + school token    | EMAIL_ADDRESS | PHONE_NUMBER |
| spacy_trf   | PERSON                     | ORG, FAC, GPE, LOC + school token        | -             | -            |
| hf_pii      | GIVENNAME, SURNAME         | -                                        | EMAIL         | TELEPHONENUM |
| gpt4o_mini  | NAME                       | SCHOOL                                   | EMAIL         | PHONE        |

"+ school token": a place or organisation span counts as SCHOOL only when one
of school / academy / high / middle is a word inside the span or the word
directly before or after it; otherwise it is OTHER. (Presidio's default
recognizers do not emit ORGANIZATION; the row is there for completeness.)
USERNAME (edshield, hf_pii, gpt4o_mini) is OTHER: the brief's secondary labels
are school, email and phone.
